notes: Fallback for any mid laner without its own mid playbook. Same safety logic as the top playbooks, but no champion-specific power spikes. After laning it says to clear mid and play with the team around objectives instead of split pushing.

motivation: Play your windows, not your emotions. Let's go.
Calm lane, clean waves, big spikes. This one is yours.
One trade at a time. Good luck, have fun.

modes.headline: Low HP: back off
modes.reason: Step out of range or recall

modes.headline: {soon.label} in {clock(soon.in)}

modes.headline: Trade & farm

modes.headline: Stay with your team
modes.reason: You're the frontline: fights are won when you're there to engage or peel. Farm the side lane only when no objective is coming
modes.voice: You're the frontline. Stay with your team.

modes.headline: {fed.names} {fed.verb} fed: don't get caught
modes.reason: Clear mid and stay near your team; take side waves only up to the river. Leave as soon as {fed.names} {fed.verb} missing

modes.headline: You win fights vs {oppName}: play for objectives
modes.reason: {reason ? reason + ' · ' : ''}Clear mid, then move first to the next objective with your team; catch the side wave on that side

modes.headline: Clear mid, farm near your team
modes.reason: Take the side wave on the side of the next objective; leave if two come{jgNote ? ' · ' + jgNote : ''}

modes.reason: {reason || 'Stay near your team; clear waves under your towers'}
